result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. Visibility at the corner is significantly hindered by a large tree and parked vehicles, creating potential conflicts between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are provided at the intersection to guide pedestrians or alert motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree and parked vehicles at the corner block the view of oncoming traffic for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right corner near the silver truck

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk lacks ADA-compliant ramps, creating a barrier for people with mobility impairments.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the corner to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and street lighting. Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or on unpaved grass, and there is no designated infrastructure to facilitate safe crossing at the intersection.

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: No paved walkways exist, forcing pedestrians to share the travel lane with motor vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks crosswalks or any pedestrian-specific signage, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Large trees at the corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
